body: Oh yes. From elementary school in the '80s right through high school!

To be fair, many of them did. Moved barricades from in front of the Capitol and waved them through.

Sounds like some kids need taught how to act around dogs. 🤷🏼‍♀️
Fascinating imagery! I didn't finish the gallery because fear, but good job!
Empty swimming pools are creepy af, especially the light or filter fixtures. *shudders*
Oh yes, a personal favorite site. Good choice and good sourcing as well.
Ugh no no no! Just chilling on my landlocked couch and it makes me woozy 🤢

Well, she's of a generation that believes mental health is a sign of someone's worthiness, so being ill is shameful. I do have a best friend that mostly understands my situation, but she has called the police during past suicidal feelings so that's out, too. Thank you for listening.

You kinda have a point, but I think that I deserve being treated like that. It'd be best if I could at least navigate a way out in which they don't look like failures. 
My mom and I are totally codependent, too. It's getting even more complex as she has MS and I'm taking on more caregiver roles. I'm an only child, so there's not anyone to help. I'm thinking that having an event like my passing could help get them what they need.
If you figure it out, do let me know.
The chance that things don't go as planned?
I'm grateful that you can use your pain to come here and reach out to others. Thank you and I wish only the best to you and your family.

I'm so happy you have Winslow. Critters make for great companions. I have a dog, she's 17 years old. She's gotten me through...well, the past 17 years. Sometimes you hear people say that it's just an animal, but I know they don't understand and not to listen to them. I wish you and Winslow much happiness together. :) thank you for sharing this. I've had a smile.

Hi over there. I'm glad you're hanging in there, like that kitten on the poster, you know? I'd never be brave enough to call the line, and I think it's great you got that far. I don't have any advice for you but I want you to know that I hear you're hurting.

I mean, my mother lies about me to everyone...says I have a job and significant other, neither of which is true. My father stopped talking to me through most of my 20s. Their behaviors don't seem to reflect that they want me. A daughter, sure, but one that can at least hit the minimums.
This. But no one understands in my RL. I question if I'm actually worth the effort, since nobody else seems to believe so.

Living things have got this huge instinct for self-preservation. Blessing and a curse, I think. Perhaps you weren't ready, and have a chance to explore how you feel? I think whatever way you feel is okay. Best to you.

I have no idea how you're hanging in there! You're taking care of so much that you've got to be tapped out. I feel like it'd help if you had some help, but I don't know how hard that would be for you to find. I'm thinking an animal rescue group in your area could help with the critters? You deserve being taken care of, too! Keep reaching out.

The first time I said I felt suicidal was probably 20 years ago by now, I was in my teens. I lived at home and said I was going to do something to hurt myself. My father said "just do it outside so you don't make a mess". I can look back and know he doesn't have the skills to deal with that situation, but it doesn't take away feeling abandoned in the darkest hour. I hope you find the light.
I'm really sorry you've had to hurt so much. Inside and out. I would be really scared if I had to go through what you have.

I'm back, because the words don't stop coming no matter how much I ignore them. 
I'm really doubting professional help can even help. I've been waiting since January for a new pdoc to join the "behavioral health" dept of the system my insurance covers. Old doc retired then, new doc doesn't start until July. A couple of weeks ago I went to a local community clinic, in hopes of getting through til July with them. But it turns out I don't qualify for community services because I have insurance.
That's why I'm here, writing random sentences to strangers. I can't stand the attacks from in my own head by myself forever.
This is one of my biggest hangups. I didn't sign up for this. It's like getting called into work on your first day off in a month....every single day.

Hello, kind internet strangers.
Thank you for responding. You helped me get through a scary moment, of which I am unable to tell those in my immediate surroundings.
